name: proteus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Proteus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Proteus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Proteus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Proteus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Proteus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
